name: External browser scroll
description: Scrolls the temporary Peer-managed Chromium viewport or a target element.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 滚动临时 Peer 托管 Chromium 的视口或目标元素。
localizedDescription.en-US: Scrolls the temporary Peer-managed Chromium viewport or a target element.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector of the element or nearest scrollable ancestor. Supports frame:N prefix.

deltaX.description: Horizontal scroll delta in CSS pixels.

deltaY.description: Vertical scroll delta in CSS pixels.

block.description: scrollIntoView block alignment: start | center | end | nearest.
